environment.description: Linux; frozen CW-14 causal pending-delta candidate; raw-log caps, accounting, concurrency, failures, path safety and metadata-admission separation fixtures

items.evidence: Fixtures verify default and overrideable 64 MiB/run and 512 MiB/project raw-log caps, exact retained prefixes at before/at/over boundaries, whichever-cap-first accounting, reopen and same-run/process concurrency, immutable status, path/TOCTOU failure closure, and preservation of unrelated result/sentinel files without deletion.

Fixtures verify raw-log open/write/scan/lock/fsync and malformed-entry failures return observable status without stopping the run, causal pending deltas preserve exact missing counts across repeated failures and same-run concurrent writers, safe recovery applies each local delta once, and raw-log health remains separate from the metadata admission latch that reopens only on explicit durable success.
